verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the VC practice counts incubators and accelerators among its clients, and offers a TwoVenture guidance hub and a free term sheet generator for startups. None of this documents a program or partnership with accelerators, incubators or university ecosystems that gives early startups structured access to the firm. Advising accelerators as clients is not the same as a startup-access program, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.
